# v1.0.1 · Cable, please

### Improved

- **Tells you when the keyboard is wireless.** The screen can only be updated over the USB cable (Corsair's own Web Hub can't do it wirelessly either). Instead of a vague "keyboard not found", TrackDeck now says to plug in the cable, and picks things up again once you do.

**Full changelog:** [v1.0.0...v1.0.1](https://github.com/yourgirljolyne/TrackDeck/compare/v1.0.0...v1.0.1)
